title: Witness the archive profile in single-wire read-only release and recovery tests
outcome: Use distinct runtime identities for both profiles in read-only child release/recovery fixtures, or assert recorded archive origin equals the child's profile. Single-wire aliasing makes shared_codex_profile_holding return Default for a read-only child and permits an impossible mixed-profile path without detecting it.
acceptance: Read-only release and recovery tests assert the correct archive origin profile and discriminate an incorrect Default profile.
